pick.preconditions: state.obj_pos.get(obj) == location and state.robot_pos == location and state.holding == False and state.inspected and state.power_com_available

place.preconditions: state.holding == obj and state.robot_pos == location and state.locating_done == True
place.effects:
state.obj_pos[obj] = location
state.holding = False
state.placement_done = True
state.placement_ok = True

repick.preconditions: state.obj_pos.get(obj) == location and state.robot_pos == location and state.placement_done == True and state.placement_ok == False and state.holding == False
repick.effects:
state.obj_pos[obj] = 'hand'
state.holding = obj
state.locating_done = False
state.placement_done = False

locating_screw.preconditions: state.holding == 'screw' and state.placement_ok == True and hole not in state.screws_tightened

fasten_screw.effects:
state.screws_tightened.append(hole)
state.holding = False
state.screw_aligned = None
state.screw_inserted = None
state.current_screw = None

position_and_place_success.name: position_and_place_success
position_and_place_success.subtasks: [("move", component, target), ("locating", component, target), ("place", component, target)]

retry_placement_method.name: retry_placement_method
retry_placement_method.preconditions: state.placement_ok == False and state.obj_pos.get(component) == target and state.holding == False
retry_placement_method.subtasks: [("repick", component, target), ("locating", component, target), ("place", component, target)]

tighten_screw_method.name: tighten_screw_method
tighten_screw_method.preconditions: state.placement_ok == True and hole not in state.screws_tightened
tighten_screw_method.subtasks: [("fetch_screw",), ("locating_screw", screw, hole), ("insert_screw", screw, hole), ("fasten_screw", screw, hole)]
